item.title: Apple to Tighten Mac Full Disk Access Controls Amid AI Agent Risks
item.description:
Apple to Tighten Mac Full Disk Access Controls Amid AI Agent Risks

Apple has announced plans to tighten the way apps are granted Full Disk Access on macOS, citing growing risks as AI agents become more capable and autonomous. The company warned that this broad permission can expose highly sensitive data and bypasses the privacy controls normally used to protect user data.

🔍 Overview

Full Disk Access is one of the broadest permissions available in macOS. While it is intended for software like backup tools, it allows apps to reach data that is otherwise protected behind separate privacy controls. Apple reports that some developers are currently using this permission in ways that could put users at risk by exposing several types of data:

  • Personal files
  • Email messages
  • Messages
  • Browsing history
  • Sensitive data across large parts of a system

⚙️ Key Details

Apple directly linked the upcoming changes to the rise of agentic AI software. Unlike traditional apps that might need access for a single function, AI agents can carry out tasks across multiple apps, files, and services.

Feature Description
Permission Level One of the broadest in macOS; bypasses standard privacy controls.
Original Intent Designed for utilities such as backup software.
Current Concern AI agents may expose significantly more personal info than traditional apps.
Privacy Stance Positioned as a central part of Apple’s on-device and cloud-based AI processing.

🧩 How it Works

The company intends to introduce additional controls that require more explicit user action before an app can receive Full Disk Access. The goal of these protections is to ensure users clearly understand the risks involved and make a deliberate, informed decision before granting such broad access to their data.

🚀 Availability

Apple has not announced exactly what the new Full Disk Access controls will look like or when they will arrive. The company stated only that the additional protections will be introduced going forward as it continues to expand artificial intelligence across the Mac through Apple Intelligence and Siri AI.

#Apple #macOS #AIAgents #Privacy #Cybersecurity

Source: Apple plans tougher Mac Full Disk Access controls as AI agents expand

item.title: Meta Patches Zero-Day Vulnerability in Muse macOS App
item.description:
Meta Patches Zero-Day Vulnerability in Muse macOS App

Meta has released a hotfix for its Muse macOS app to address a zero-day vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take control of the AI agent.

🧩 How it works

Security researcher Patrick Wardle discovered a bug involving an undocumented Muse setting. This flaw allowed attackers running local code to:

  • Redirect transcription processing from Meta’s servers to their own endpoint.
  • Gain access to the user’s Muse account.

Wardle’s proof-of-concept attacks demonstrated the ability to write malicious files to disk and take pictures, often without alerting the user.

⚙️ Key details

Several design decisions contributed to the vulnerability:

  • Muse dictation occurs in the cloud rather than on-device.
  • Any app is permitted to control all undocumented settings within Muse.

💡 Why it matters

Meta asserts that real-world security concerns were minimal because the exploit required local access to the user’s device. David Singleton of Meta Superintelligence Labs stated on X: “This was a local privilege escalation attack, not a remote exploit. Using it to do harm therefore requires malicious code already running on the user’s machine under their user account and the practical risk to users of the Muse Mac app was therefore quite low.”

🚀 Availability

While the app has faced a security flaw and was recently blocked from Amazon’s e-commerce platform, the launch has seen significant growth:

  • Estimated downloads of the Muse mobile app in the US and Canada outpaced ChatGPT’s 12-day debut.
  • Meta stock rose by 11 percent on Monday.

#Meta #Muse #Cybersecurity #macOS #AIagents

Source: Meta patches Muse exploit that let attackers control the AI agent

item.title: Apple Updates Software with New Apple Intelligence Features and Platform Improvements
item.description:
Apple Updates Software with New Apple Intelligence Features and Platform Improvements

Apple has released software updates delivering a new generation of Apple Intelligence features and platform improvements for its devices, including the 2027 software releases.

🧠 Apple Intelligence Features

Apple Intelligence introduces tools to make daily apps smarter and more useful:

Feature Capability
Photos Includes Spatial Reframing, Extend, and an upgraded Clean Up tool for editing photos.
Image Playground Creates high-quality images in various styles, including photorealistic, with metadata and upcoming SynthID support.
Safari Automatically organizes tabs into topics, notifies users of website changes (price drops or restocks), and enables custom extensions based on descriptions.
Call Context Surfaces relevant information, such as reservation numbers or confirmation codes, during business calls.

🛡️ Parental Controls and Safety

New features allow parents to create safer digital experiences for children:

  • Account Setup: A new flow for child accounts simplifies enabling age-based safeguards.
  • App Management: Parents can choose specific apps children access and add more over time.
  • Safari: “Ask to Browse” requires parental approval before children access new websites.
  • Communication Safety: Blocks gore or violent content in shared images and videos, and allows parents to approve new contacts.
  • Screen Time: A redesigned intuitive view shows average device usage and top apps. This includes Schedules to manage app access at different times of the day and daily total time allowances for Social Media, Games, and Entertainment apps.

⚙️ Platform and Performance Improvements

The 2027 software releases include several performance and design refinements:

  • Speed Increases:
    • iPhone and iPad: Apps launch up to 30% faster, photos load up to 70% faster, and AirDrop transfers are up to 80% faster.
    • iPad: File browsing and transfers to external USB drives are up to 5x faster; improvements to multitasking window management.
    • Apple Vision Pro: Wi-Fi connection and startup are up to 3x faster.
    • Apple Watch: Faster music playback.
  • Connectivity and Stability:
    • Seamless transitions between cellular and Wi-Fi on iPhone and iPad.
    • Messages now allows subsequent texts to go through while large media is being delivered in low-bandwidth situations.
    • Faster network file browsing on Mac.
    • More stable and comprehensive search across Mail, Photos, and Spotlight, with a new ranking system for Top Hits in Mail.
  • Design: Refinements using “Liquid Glass” include sharper app icons and a Settings slider to adjust the appearance from ultraclear to fully tinted.

#AppleIntelligence #iOS #macOS #SoftwareUpdate #ParentalControls

Source: Major updates for Apple’s software platforms are now available
